home.title: Overlay — the notch for Windows
home.description: Overlay puts a Dynamic Island–style notch at the top of your Windows screen: music with synced lyrics, a focus timer, your calendar, AI usage limits for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, Discord calls and more. Everything stays on your PC.

features.title: Features — Overlay, the notch for Windows
features.description: Now Playing with synced lyrics, AI usage limits for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity, Google Calendar, a focus timer, Discord voice calls, GitHub, to-dos, clipboard history, hardware stats and more, in one notch.

faq.a: Overlay is a free Windows app that adds a Dynamic Island–style notch to the top of the screen. It shows what is playing with synced lyrics, a focus timer, your next calendar event, the usage limits of AI coding tools and more, and opens into a full set of tools on a click or hover.

faq.q: Which versions of Windows does Overlay support?
faq.a: Overlay runs on Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit.
Yes. Basic is free forever. Pro costs $49 a year and Lifetime costs $149 once; the Windows beta is free while it lasts.

faq.q: Which AI tools does Overlay track?
faq.a: Overlay reads local usage for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI and Antigravity, shows session and weekly limits, and can hand your work to another tool with its context when one runs low.
No. Overlay reads the logs your tools already keep on your PC and stores your account, notes, to-dos and history locally. Nothing is uploaded to Overlay.
Yes. Now Playing works with Spotify and any player that appears in the Windows media controls, with play, skip, volume and synced lyrics.
